import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectivePullbackLinearForms
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4OrdinaryFiberBasePointFree
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4TangentSectionConverse

/-!
# Divisor orders in a local frame

A frame normalized by a global divisor section identifies its local
coefficients with ratios of rational functions. If the denominator has
nonzero fiber, a coefficient with irreducible germ gives a simple zero of the
numerator as a section of the divisor module. This is the local order step
in the intrinsic very-ampleness converse of Hartshorne IV.3.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

/-- A local frame normalized by a global section computes rational values
by multiplication with the frame coefficient. -/
theorem divisorSection_value_eq_mul_of_frame
    (D : CurveDivisor k X) (W : LocalRatioOpen X)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.U.ι).obj (divisorModule D) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit W.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (s t : Γ(divisorModule D, ⊤)) (a : Γ(X.left, W.U))
    (hs : (e.hom.app ⊤).hom ((divisorModule D).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : W.U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : W.U.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op s) =
      W.U.topIso.inv a)
    (ht : (e.hom.app ⊤).hom ((divisorModule D).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : W.U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : W.U.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op t) =
      (1 : Γ(W.U.toScheme, ⊤))) :
    (show divisorSections D ⊤ from s : X.left.functionField) =
      localStructureValue W a * (show divisorSections D ⊤ from t : X.left.functionField) := by
  let U : X.left.Opens := W.U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : W.U.toScheme.Opens)
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.U.ι).obj (divisorModule D)
  let sU : Γ(N, ⊤) :=
    (divisorModule D).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op s
  let tU : Γ(N, ⊤) :=
    (divisorModule D).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op t
  have hsec : sU = (W.U.topIso.inv a) • tU := by
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (e.hom.app ⊤)).injective
    rw [show (e.hom.app ⊤).hom ((W.U.topIso.inv a) • tU) =
        (W.U.topIso.inv a) * (show Γ(W.U.toScheme, ⊤) from
          (e.hom.app ⊤).hom tU) from
      (e.hom.val.app (op ⊤)).hom.map_smul (W.U.topIso.inv a) tU,
      ht, mul_one]
    exact hs
  have hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty := by
    rw [show U = W.U from W.U.ι_image_top]
    exact W.nonempty
  have hval := congrArg
    (fun z : divisorSections D U => (z : X.left.functionField)) hsec
  change (divisorSectionsRes D (le_top : U ≤ ⊤) s : X.left.functionField) =
    (divisorSectionAction D U
      ((W.U.ι.appIso ⊤).inv (W.U.topIso.inv a))
      (divisorSectionsRes D (le_top : U ≤ ⊤) t) : X.left.functionField) at hval
  rw [divisorSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty D U hU,
    divisorSectionsRes_coe le_top hU, divisorSectionsRes_coe le_top hU] at hval
  refine hval.trans (congrArg (fun z => z *
    (show divisorSections D ⊤ from t : X.left.functionField)) ?_)
  change (X.left.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X.left)
      (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)).hom
        ((W.U.ι.appIso ⊤).inv (W.U.topIso.inv a)) =
    (X.left.presheaf.germ W.U (genericPoint X.left) W.generic_mem).hom a
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv, Scheme.Opens.topIso_inv]
  exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply X.left.presheaf
    (eqToHom W.U.ι_image_top) (genericPoint X.left) _ a

/-- A simple zero of a coefficient in a frame normalized by a nonvanishing
global section realizes the divisor bound after deleting the point once. -/
theorem orderAt_eq_devissageBound_of_irreducible_frame_coefficient
    (D : CurveDivisor k X) (W : LocalRatioOpen X)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.U.ι).obj (divisorModule D) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit W.U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (s t : Γ(divisorModule D, ⊤)) (a : Γ(X.left, W.U))
    (hs : (e.hom.app ⊤).hom ((divisorModule D).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : W.U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : W.U.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op s) =
      W.U.topIso.inv a)
    (ht : (e.hom.app ⊤).hom ((divisorModule D).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : W.U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : W.U.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op t) =
      (1 : Γ(W.U.toScheme, ⊤)))
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (hxW : x ∈ W.U)
    (htx : Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation (divisorModule D) x t ≠ 0)
    (ha : Irreducible ((X.left.presheaf.germ W.U x hxW).hom a)) :
    orderAt X.hom hx (show divisorSections D ⊤ from s : X.left.functionField) =
      divisorBound (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor hx D) hx := by
  have htjump : jumpProj hx D ⊤ trivial
      (show divisorSections D ⊤ from t) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply htx
    apply stalkJumpFiberAddHom_of_divisorModule_injective hx D
    rw [map_zero, stalkJumpFiberAddHom_of_divisorModule_fiberEvaluation, stalkJump_germ]
    exact hz
  have htorder := (jumpProj_ne_zero_iff_orderAt_eq_divisorBound hx
    (by trivial) (show divisorSections D ⊤ from t)).mp htjump
  rw [divisorSection_value_eq_mul_of_frame D W e s t a hs ht, map_mul,
    orderAt_eq_exp_neg_one_of_irreducible_germ W a hx hxW ha, htorder,
    divisorBound_eq_coeffAt, divisorBound_eq_coeffAt, devissageDivisor_coeffAt]
  change WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ) * WithZero.exp (CurveDivisor.coeffAt hx D) =
    WithZero.exp (CurveDivisor.coeffAt hx D - 1)
  rw [← WithZero.exp_add]
  congr 1
  omega

end
end Hartshorne
